trackerDown: The tracker is not running, so nothing new can load. What is on screen is what was last loaded. This notice goes away once the tracker answers again.

footer.local: Your match history is kept on this computer. No account needed.

liveStatus.unreachable: This page cannot reach the tracker. What is on screen is what was last loaded.
liveStatus.following: The tracker is following Arena's log as you play.
liveStatus.notWatching: The tracker is running without watching Arena's log, so a match played now is not recorded by it. Restart the tracker with watching turned on.
liveStatus.watcherStopped: The tracker stopped watching Arena's log after it started, so a match played now is not recorded. Restart the tracker; its log file says what went wrong.
liveStatus.mtgoWatched: MTGO is watched too: each game appears once it ends.
